column495: Dear Hiring Manager, I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Network Administrator / Network Security Engineer role at your organisation. With approximately 3 years of hands-on experience in enterprise network operations, F5 load balancing and WAF management, firewall administration, and ITSM-driven incident handling, I am confident in my ability to contribute meaningfully to your infrastructure team from day one. A core strength of mine is my expertise with F5 BIG-IP technologies — specifically LTM (Local Traffic Manager), GTM (Global Traffic Manager), and WAF (Web Application Firewall). In my previous role at Capgemini Technology Services, I was responsible for monitoring and managing servers, pools, and virtual servers on F5 LTM via the F5 GUI, administering GTM for DNS-based global traffic distribution, and enforcing WAF security policies for web application traffic inspection and threat mitigation. I also reviewed iRule configurations and maintained pool member health to ensure maximum service availability. Beyond F5, I bring broad expertise in network security and NOC operations. I have administered Fortigate, Fortimanager, Fortianalyzer, and Check Point firewalls, managed Bluecoat Proxy for URL filtering and policy enforcement, and handled IPAM operations using Netbox and Infoblox. I have actively supported SOC teams by reviewing firewall logs, monitoring SIEM alerts, and coordinating with ISPs and TAC engineers to uphold SLA commitments. My experience spans routing protocols (OSPF, BGP), switching (Cisco ASR, Nexus 7K/9K), and SDN platforms including DNAC and APIC (Cisco ACI). In terms of operational delivery, I supervised a team of 12 engineers and consistently resolved over 1,000+ tickets per month across 12 enterprise clients while maintaining a 100% escalation-free record. I am well-versed in ITSM frameworks, having worked extensively with ServiceNow and BMC Remedy for incident and change management — including handling incidents and changes efficiently to maintain uninterrupted service continuity. I hold a Fortinet Certified Associate in Cybersecurity (2025) and have completed certifications in ITIL 4, AWS Machine Learning, Google Analytics IQ, CCNA fundamentals, SRE, and Windows Server Administration through Pluralsight and Coursera. I hold an MCA (CGPA: 8.0) from BPUT University, providing a solid academic foundation in computer science alongside my practical experience. I am eager to bring my technical depth, operational discipline, and collaborative approach to a dynamic organisation where I can contribute to robust, secure, and high-performing network infrastructure. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with your team's goals. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Keshav Kumar Jha Senior Network Administrator | F5 LTM / GTM / WAF | Network Security +91 7008536491 | ultraking69@gmail.com

column495: Dear Hiring Manager, I am writing to express my interest in the L2 Network Security Engineer position. I have 3.5+ years of experience in enterprise network operations, network troubleshooting, and telecom infrastructure management. In my current role as an L1 Network Engineer, I have hands-on experience with Cisco routers and switches, LAN/WAN, VLAN, STP, OSPF, BGP, Internet Leased Line (ILL), and enterprise network troubleshooting. I also have experience working with Fortinet Firewall, including firewall policy management, NAT, ACLs, VPN troubleshooting, and security-related incident resolution. I am experienced in monitoring network infrastructure using tools such as SolarWinds, PRTG, Zabbix, and Nagios, as well as coordinating with ISPs and resolving L2/L3 network issues within SLA timelines. I am confident that my networking and security knowledge, troubleshooting skills, and enterprise infrastructure experience would allow me to contribute effectively to your team. I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss how my skills and experience align with this role.

column495: MUHAMMED AMEENU RAHMAN TK Network & Security Engineer | CCNA Certified Pune, Maharashtra +91 9633939063 ameenmahi7@gmail.com linkedin.com/in/ameenmahi7 August 24, 2026 Hiring Manager / Talent Acquisition Team Cestech / Enterprise Network & Security Operations Application for L2 Network & Security Engineer – Implementation Specialist Dear Hiring Team, I am writing to express my strong interest in the L2 Network & Security Engineer – Implementation Specialist position. With over five years of dedicated experience in enterprise network infrastructure operations, Next- Generation Firewall administration, and multi-vendor routing and switching, I am eager to bring my hands-on technical and implementation expertise to your team. Throughout my career at Kaiser Permanente and Totalbinary Technologies, I have specialized in architecting, deploying, and maintaining high-availability enterprise environments. My core technical strengths include: Palo Alto NGFW & Panorama Deployment: Proven track record in transitioning environments from legacy port-based policies to Layer 7 App-ID, configuring advanced Security Profiles (Threat Prevention, URL Filtering, WildFire), deploying SSL/TLS Forward Proxy decryption via internal PKI, and managing multi-site firewalls using Panorama Device Groups and Template Stacks. Identity & Posture Control: Extensive experience deploying Palo Alto User-ID via Active Directory Server Monitoring and Windows User-ID Agents, facilitating granular, identity-aware security enforcement. Core Routing, Switching & HA: Solid background configuring and troubleshooting dynamic routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), VLANs, STP, HSRP, and High Availability (Active/Passive and Active/Active) across Cisco Catalyst switches (9K/4K/C9300/C9500) and PAN-OS virtual routers. Structured Implementation & Incident Management: Skilled in authoring detailed Methods of Procedure (MOPs), performing pre-change validations, managing firmware/OS migrations with zero unplanned downtime, and rapidly resolving bridge-critical Sev-1 incidents using Splunk, NetScout, and NOM. I pride myself on a disciplined approach to network implementation combining thorough pre-staging and validation with clear cross-vendor and ISP coordination. I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your client delivery engagements and support robust, scalable security solutions. Thank you for your time and consideration. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical skills and implementation experience align with your team's goals. Sincerely, Muhammed Ameenu Rahman TK Network & Security Engineer | CCNA (200-301)
